FACTS THAT COST TIME THIS SESSION. (1) The local pair lock is real: the source declares lore 0.15.0, the installed quest is 0.14.1, so bun run lore check exits 6 locally after reading the bundle clean, and the three LCLI-614 real-quest race tests fail locally; CI SKIPS those three rather than running them green, and supplies quest 0.15.0 for the docs gate. (2) The ubuntu CI leg can stall and red across files that a tracker-only diff cannot reach; rerun --failed fixed it, and a same-head sibling PR passing the leg is the reachability control. (3) Biome hides its one error behind a diagnostic limit: run biome check --diagnostic-level=error when lint fails and the named file is not yours. (4) DEC-158 refuses git worktree operations outside the repository roots, which is why the (a3) reproduction uses plain rm -rf as the owner. (5) ladybug-lifecycle has TWO inspectors; inspectFreshGeneration is the fast path production uses, so a rule added to inspectGeneration alone does nothing. (6) A cache manifest records the CLI binary version, never the plugin that invoked it.
